item.title: Women’s basketball: Branson grad Golan has Point Loma charging toward title
item.description: Awards season brought some extra fuel to the fire for Novato's Hannah Golan and her Point Loma teammates, who open the defense of their PacWest women’s basketball title in Friday’s semifinals.

item.title: Barry Tompkins: So many draft experts, so little time
item.description: I admit it. I do listen to sports talk radio.

item.title: Clipper upgrade glitch rattles Marin, Bay Area transit
item.description: Passengers have contended with disappearing account balances, trouble loading new value on cards, malfunctioning ticket machines and other problems.

item.title: ‘Control the chaos’: Marin holds drill for mass casualty incident
item.description: County staff and volunteers practiced reuniting victims with relatives and friends at a simulated emergency center.

item.title: Sports briefs: Marin Catholic rolls into NorCal final
item.description: Tam High girls lacrosse saw scoring from 11 different players during Wednesday's 17-4 road victory over Rancho Cotate.

item.title: Slow start costs Cal women in ACC Tournament loss to Syracuse
item.description: After trailing 37-16 at halftime, Cal staged a big comeback in their eventual 70-59 second-round loss, closing within four points midway through the fourth quarter.

item.description: A shorthanded Warriors team plays first game in Houston since the 2025 playoffs

item.title: Boys soccer: Branson keeps rolling into first NorCal final
item.description: Ethan Winter helped set up the first goal and scored the second one as the Branson School boys soccer team’s first foray into the NorCal playoffs has the Bulls one step away from a championship.

item.title: Girls soccer: Marin Catholic returns to NorCal D-IV final
item.description: The Marin Catholic High girls soccer team is catching fire at the right time -- kind of like the Wildcats have done this before.
